headline_pain: Rates Scary? Do the Real Maths.
primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." Fair enough. But have you compared repayments to your rent? Even at current rates, many small businesses find their mortgage repayment on a Truganina warehouse is comparable to — or less than — what they're paying in rent. Except now you're building equity. And when rates drop, your repayments fall too. Rent never drops. Off-the-plan pricing in Truganina, right off Princes Freeway. 20km from the CBD. Run the numbers with us — they might surprise you.
description: Warehouse repayments often match current rent — but you build equity every month.
